# includeSeparator

Kind: presentation setting.

`includeSeparator` controls whether the tool writes a generated separator between metadata presentation and document body.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| JSON type | boolean |
| Allowed values | `true`, `false` |
| Default behavior | The default manifest uses `true`. |
| Controls | Separator output after metadata or presentation. |

Markdown output uses the configured presentation separator. Plain text output uses a plain separator line.

See [presentation](../presentation.md).
